interpretation.scope: Five locally saved Golden matching results, ten seeds, forward directions, two alternating-order repetitions per revision.
interpretation.comparison: Every catalogue field is hashed after expanding provenance for the audit and omitting only storage schema and shared-history encoding. Audit expansion is outside stage timings.
interpretation.resource_limits: 120-second process watchdog per measurement; no 2 GiB guard. Process peak RSS includes explicit comparison audits.

stage_breakdown.method: CPython 3.12 local line monitoring at five once-per-cut boundaries; other line locations disabled after first notification. Paired uninstrumented controls. No source changes.
stage_breakdown.measurement_scope: Same five saved seed-ten forward directions; loading, hashing, decoding, verification and publication excluded. Three alternating-order paired repetitions. Boundary callbacks verified once per cut. Branch grouping stage includes record construction, placement handling and provenance attachment, not just hash-table probes.

key_lookup_breakdown.method: Capture actual lookup keys from the unchanged reducer, then time a fresh dictionary with membership checks and integer-ID insertion for every captured key. Key construction, payload construction, I/O and provenance are excluded. No synthetic keys.
